data.long_meaning: From the Latin word stella, meaning star. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the star that guided the Magi to the birthplace of Jesus. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Estele usually hope their child will grow to embody star of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
